text:
jordan: FYI i flipped tenant `beta-hub` to prefer v2 for a 5% canary at 09:05 PT. noticed the routes dashboard flagged a token "spike" to v1 within the first 3m. anyone on routing/metrics?

analytics-bot: flag: tenant.beta-hub route-change detected @2024-11-12T16:05:00Z. canary-size=5%. metric: tokens_by_meter increased on meter_key:v1 ~+1200 over baseline.

anya: pulling traces now. router logs show chosen_route=v2 for most reqs, but billing shows meter_key=v1 for the same req ids. looks like we have eventual consistency between routing config and billing meter mapping.

tess: did we leave tenant pinning on? sticky pins can cause cross-version attribution if a fallback triggers later.

jordan: pinning was enabled (TTL=600s) because i wanted consistent session routing for UX testing.

rob: likely cause: the billing service caches tenant -> meter_key mapping for 10m to reduce DB load. when the canary toggles, the router uses the new mapping immediately but billing still uses cached value until TTL expiry. that explains the temporary v1 attribution.

mike: two concerns: 1) PMs see the stacked chart and assume v2 failing; 2) quotas could be misapplied if we charge against old SKU for a period.

anya: short term fixes: set pin.ttl=0 for beta-hub to avoid sticky handoffs; and reduce billing.cache.ttl to 20s for canary-labeled tenants. we can do both immediately.

tess: agree. also can we add a console annotation when toggling flags: "billing attribution may lag up to Xs due to memoization" so stakeholders don't misinterpret spikes? a small toast + help link should be fine.

rob: on the infra side: we can emit a lightweight invalidation event over pubsub when tenant-routing config changes. billing workers subscribe and invalidate local memo for that tenant. low-risk and quick. i'll make a tiny PR.

jordan: i'll flip pin.ttl to 0 for beta-hub now. giving the console a heads-up first.

analytics-bot: runtime-change: pin.ttl(beta-hub)=0 by jordan @2024-11-12T16:09:12Z.

mike: also add a temporary increase in trace sampling for that tenant (100%) for 30m so we get more end-to-end traces for verification.

anya: adding trace override runtime flag now. opsbot can apply.

analytics-bot: runtime-flag: trace.sample_override(beta-hub)=100% active 30m.

rob: opened PR #5022: "emit tenant-routing:update on config flips". includes unit test and a small e2e that verifies billing memo invalidation within 1s of publish. scheduling review.

tess: i'll sketch the console toast copy: "Route change in progress — billing and quota metrics may take up to 2 minutes to reflect new routes. Learn more (link)." put it under the toggle action and make it dismissible.

mike: +1. UX question: should we expose "show by chosen route / show by billing key" on the routes chart? that would make the mismatch explicit.

tess: yes — i think a two-state chart is the cleanest. default stays as-is, with a small legend badge explaining eventual consistency windows and a timestamp of last billing-sync for the tenant.

jordan: after pin change and putting the trace override, the metric realigned after ~45s. looks stable now. no lingering fallbacks in logs either.

anya: follow-up actions/owners: rob -> pubsub invalidation PR + prod rollout checklist; tess -> dashboard toggle + toast mock; mike -> add a canary runbook step to temporarily set billing.cache.ttl lower and pin.ttl=0; jordan -> retro notes with PM.

rob: noted. i'll aim to ship invalidation to staging by EOD and prod next Tue after one canary validation.

mike: one more ask: can analytics surface an "attribution-lag" metric per tenant so we can auto-suppress ephemeral alerts when route flips happen? could be a simple gauge: last_billing_sync_age.

anya: yes we already track last_config_apply timestamps in the routing service. analytics can compute delta to billing's last_meter_update and expose as last_billing_sync_age. i'll add a quick dashboard.

analytics-bot: alert suggestion: suppress quota-alerts for tenant where last_billing_sync_age > 60s and recent `tenant-routing:update` within 5m.

mike: perfect. i'll prepare a short RFC describing these changes and the tiny UX copy. closing thread once PRs and toast mock are linked. thanks :thumbsup:
